before.description: Die lernende Person kann das Prinzip der Gaschromatografie über Trägergas, stationäre Phase und unterschiedliche zwischenmolekulare Wechselwirkungen erklären und Gaschromatogramme durch Retentionszeitvergleiche mit Referenzen unter gleichen Bedingungen zur begrenzten Identifizierung von Gemischbestandteilen auswerten.
before.subject: chemie
before.aiNotes: Independent actual PNG KEEP; native1672x941 and whole360x203/680x383 were actually viewed. The left-to-right carrier-gas path is visibly separate from the orange stationary film on the inner column wall. A mixture is introduced before the column; the detector is downstream. The drawing is a schematic GC model, not a TLC solvent front or a claimed actual run. The violet square is furthest downstream, red triangle intermediate, green circle furthest upstream. The main signal plots earliest violet, then red, then green; that qualitative retention order is coherent. The enlarged circle shows green interacting reversibly near the stationary film with a two-way arrow while red advances with the mobile flow. Signal and reference have rightward time axes. The red reference peak aligns vertically with the middle red mixture peak, with a same-conditions label. No numerical retention times, substance identities, calibrated peak areas, quantity inference or unique-identity claim are printed. Different schematic peak heights are not labelled as concentrations or amounts. Shapes/colours are representational species keys, not evidence that co-retention guarantees a unique real compound. The image remains orientation; its generic example does not override the supplied case data. before.title: Dünnschichtchromatographie erklären und Rf-Daten deuten
before.description: Die lernende Person kann das Trennprinzip einer planaren Dünnschichtchromatographie mit den unterschiedlichen Wechselwirkungen der Stoffe mit stationärer und mobiler Phase erklären, Rf-Werte aus bereitgestellten Laufstrecken ermitteln und Stoffvergleiche unter gleichen Bedingungen sowie deren Grenzen begründen.
before.subject: chemie
before.aiNotes: Independent actual PNG KEEP; native1672x941 and whole360x203/680x383 were actually viewed. The TLC startline is above the solvent surface; the plate bottom contacts the mobile phase. The dashed solvent front stops below the plate top. The upward mobile-phase arrow and stationary-phase pointer distinguish the two phases. The two inset measurement arrows a and b share the same startline. The purple a ends at the purple spot-height guide; b ends at the solvent-front guide. Both are distances along the same migration direction and a<b, consistent with dimensionless Rf=a/b. The measurement inset is slightly proportionally rescaled rather than aligned pixel-for-pixel with the plate. Approximate visual coordinates: main baseline609/front178/purplecentre356 gives253/431≈0.587; inset baseline609/front197/purpleguide367 gives242/412≈0.587. Drawing/spot-blur tolerance applies; these are illustration checks, not lab measurements. Thus both endpoints represent the same relative migration. A, B and U visibly share one baseline; upper/lower U spots match the illustrated reference heights under the same pictured conditions. Neither co-migration nor two visible spots is labeled as proof of unique identity, purity, exactly two components or universal Rf. The large Rf fraction and proportional arrows carry the mathematical relation without units. Colored b and the green lower spots do not contradict its endpoint: b visibly terminates at the front guide, not at that spot.
